2608.19002.title: A Theory of Post-hoc Debate Judgement
2608.19002.paper_summary: Debates have recently emerged as a useful methodology for agentic AI to improve performance as well as to aid explainability and user engagement. For example, LLM-empowered agents may debate internally (with themselves) and/or externally (with other agents). In many settings where debates are used, debates' outcomes and resulting outputs are determined post-hoc by external judges, often LLMs. In this paper we develop and test a novel theory of debate judgement applicable to all settings where agents engage in debates by providing pros and cons for their opinions therein. Specifically, we identify a number of formal properties that debate judgement may be required to satisfy in general, as concerns reproducibility, robustness, groundedness and explainability. Then, we explore their satisfaction formally and/or experimentally, for claim verification settings, for two specific alternative debate judgement methods: variants of the LLMs as a judge idea and formal semantics drawn from computational argumentation. We show that the two methods give similar accuracy performances but the former may lack formal guarantees that the latter brings. Overall, our study indicates argumentation semantics as an ideal candidate for principled judges in debate-driven AI.
2608.19002.paper_summary_zh: 最近出現的辯論被視為一種有用的方法論，可以幫助代理 AI 改進性能，並促進可解釋性和用戶參與。<lb/>例如，強大的 LLM 代理可以在內部（與自己）和/或外部（與其他代理）進行辯論。<lb/>在許多使用辯論的環境中，辯論的結果和產出通常由外部評審（通常是 LLM）事後決定。<lb/>在本文中，我們開發並測試了一種新的辯論判斷理論，適用於所有代理進行辯論的環境，通過提供其意見的利弊來實現。<lb/>具體而言，我們確定了一些辯論判斷在一般情況下可能需要滿足的正式屬性，這些屬性涉及可重複性、穩健性、基礎性和可解釋性。<lb/>然後，我們正式和/或實驗性地探索這些屬性的滿足情況，針對主張驗證設置，對兩種特定的替代辯論判斷方法進行研究：作為評審的 LLM 變體和來自計算論證的形式語義。<lb/>我們表明這兩種方法的準確性表現相似，但前者可能缺乏後者所帶來的正式保證。<lb/>總體而言，我們的研究表明論證語義是辯論驅動 AI 中原則性評審的理想候選者。
